confidence_flags: Same dense/irregular plan as the ground floor (หน้า19), drawn at 1:100 rather than 1:75. Beam marks and their own printed levels ('+3.65' etc.) were read directly; not every interior/vertical beam was resolved to an exact grid_ref pair. Treat as representative, not exhaustive — full specs for B1-B10A/B1'/B3'/B6A are captured at higher confidence on the section sheets (หน้า24/25).
warnings: This sheet carries a small secondary gable roof frame (a decorative front dormer over the entry porch, matching the gable visible in elevation หน้า07/09) drawn directly on top of the floor-2 beam grid near B7-C7: two raking members marked 'B3'' at (+3.65) forming the gable, with an 'S1' slab/ceiling panel (+3.65/+3.60) inside. Recorded as beam/slab elements in THIS file rather than splitting into a second view file, since it shares the exact same grid and is spatially inseparable from the adjacent floor beams at this scale — flagged here per the multi-view rule (§3) rather than silently merged.

A curved void near A3-A4 is explicitly labelled 'ช่องบันได' (stairwell opening) on this sheet — resolves the ambiguity left open on the ground-floor plan (หน้า19), where the same curved shape at the same grid location was recorded without a text label.

'จันทัน C100x50x20x2.3mm @1.00m', 'ตะเฆ่สัน/ตะเฆ่ราง 2C125x50x20x2.3mm', 'อกไก่ 2C125x50x20x2.3mm', 'อี,อเส 2C150x50x20x2.3mm' printed as leader labels on the left margin of this sheet all describe the MAIN hip roof steel frame, which is drawn in full on the dedicated roof structure plan (หน้า21) — not re-transcribed as separate elements here to avoid duplicating that file; only the small gable dormer local to this sheet (B3'/S1 above) was captured here.
